claim_text: A SKILL.md file must contain YAML frontmatter followed by Markdown content, and the Markdown body carrying the instructions has no format restrictions.
evidence_span: The `SKILL.md` file must contain YAML frontmatter followed by Markdown content.

claim_text: The required name field is capped at 64 characters, allows only lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens, may not start or end with a hyphen or contain consecutive hyphens, and must match the parent directory name.
evidence_span: Max 64 characters. Lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens only. Must not start or end with a hyphen.

claim_text: The required description field is capped at 1024 characters, must be non-empty, and should describe both what the skill does and when to use it, including keywords that help agents identify relevant tasks.
evidence_span: Max 1024 characters. Non-empty. Describes what the skill does and when to use it.

claim_text: Beyond name and description the spec defines four optional frontmatter fields: license, compatibility (max 500 characters, for environment requirements), metadata (an arbitrary string-to-string map), and the experimental allowed-tools.
evidence_span: Max 500 characters. Indicates environment requirements (intended product, system packages, network access, etc.).

claim_text: The optional allowed-tools field is a space-separated string of pre-approved tools and is explicitly experimental, so support for it may vary between agent implementations.
evidence_span: Experimental. Support for this field may vary between agent implementations

claim_text: The optional metadata map is the spec's extension point: clients use it to store properties the Agent Skills spec does not define, and key names should be made reasonably unique to avoid conflicts.
evidence_span: Clients can use this to store additional properties not defined by the Agent Skills spec

claim_text: The specification recommends keeping the main SKILL.md under 500 lines and moving detailed reference material to separate files, because the agent loads the entire file once it decides to activate a skill.
evidence_span: Keep your main `SKILL.md` under 500 lines. Move detailed reference material to separate files.

claim_text: Beyond the required SKILL.md a skill directory may contain any files, with scripts/, references/, and assets/ recommended as conventions rather than mandated structure.
evidence_span: A skill directory may contain any files and directories beyond the required `SKILL.md`. The conventions below are recommendations for organizing common types of content.

claim_text: Reference files should stay focused and be referenced by relative paths kept one level deep from SKILL.md, avoiding deeply nested reference chains, since agents load them on demand and smaller files use less context.
evidence_span: Keep file references one level deep from `SKILL.md`. Avoid deeply nested reference chains.

claim_text: The standard ships a reference library, skills-ref, whose validate command checks that a skill's SKILL.md frontmatter is valid and follows all naming conventions.
evidence_span: This checks that your `SKILL.md` frontmatter is valid and follows all naming conventions.
